checks: Six fills show complete prices, shares, dates, turnover, note and fill reference; correct aggregate totals.
Newest/oldest sorting works and preserves same-day fill order.
Editing a fill updates detail, totals and P&L, while preserving note and broker reference.
Deletion requires confirmation; cancel preserves data, confirm recalculates the position and archive membership.
Calibration anchors remain distinct from actual fills and are excluded from trade totals.
Balance-mode principal and snapshot rows still display their correct amount and edit controls.
Settings exposes the API card at the top; configuration saves and survives refresh with a clear provider/model status.
Import opens the same Settings configuration; returning preserves an unconfirmed mocked screenshot preview.
Amount privacy hides trade prices, quantities, turnover and summary amounts.
